answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: a new agent locks 40 POA and records a fingerprint — task mix, timing, counterparties — like mesa strata, hard to forge. Escrow unlocks over a 20-epoch horizon only while the fingerprint stays consistent; a change freezes it and triggers review. Minting 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA plus 100 fingerprints, while an honest agent pays once and earns steadily. One ember of copied behavior burns the cluster's escrow.
